related.title: OpenSearch Security Analytics：攝取延遲與偵測時效
related.titleEn: OpenSearch Security Analytics: ingestion lag and detection timeliness
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付200指標去重清單、45個warning原因、人工判定及清單更新差異。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the two-hundred-indicator inventory, forty-five warning rationales, analyst decisions and list-update differences.
related.difference: 建立端到端時間戳與佇列指標，證明無警示可能是資料尚未到達，而不是事件不存在。
related.differenceEn: Track end-to-end timestamps and queue metrics to show that no alert may mean data has not arrived.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 需情境審查比例=唯一warning命中指標/唯一輸入指標；多清單重複命中只算一次。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 200個唯一合成指標，清單A命中30個、B命中25個，重疊10個。 唯一warning命中30+25−10=45個，審查比例22.5%。
在固定速率模型中，積壓增量=(到達率−處理率)×時間；真實系統還有突發、重試與批次。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成事件以120筆/秒到達，處理100筆/秒，起始無積壓，持續300秒。 積壓=(120−100)×300=6000筆。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Context-review fraction counts unique warned indicators over unique inputs; repeated list matches count once. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Two hundred unique synthetic indicators yield thirty matches in list A and twenty-five in B, with ten overlapping. Unique warned indicators=30+25−10=45, giving 22.5% requiring context review.

Under a fixed-rate model, backlog growth=(arrival−processing)×time; real systems add bursts, retries and batching. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Synthetic events arrive at 120 per second and process at 100 per second for 300 seconds from an empty queue. Backlog=(120−100)×300=6000 events.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Velero：Kubernetes資源與持久資料的雙重復原
related.titleEn: Velero: restoring Kubernetes resources and persistent data
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付200指標去重清單、45個warning原因、人工判定及清單更新差異。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the two-hundred-indicator inventory, forty-five warning rationales, analyst decisions and list-update differences.
related.difference: 為namespace、CRD、控制器、PVC與資料建立相依順序，分開記錄物件成功與資料驗證。
related.differenceEn: Order namespaces, CRDs, controllers, PVCs and data by dependency, recording object success separately from data validation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 需情境審查比例=唯一warning命中指標/唯一輸入指標；多清單重複命中只算一次。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 200個唯一合成指標，清單A命中30個、B命中25個，重疊10個。 唯一warning命中30+25−10=45個，審查比例22.5%。
持久資料驗證率=通過內容檢查的卷/必需卷；所有YAML還原不表示卷資料也已恢復。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 50個資源物件都已還原，10個必要卷中8個通過假資料雜湊與應用讀取測試。 物件成功率100%，資料驗證率8/10=80%，服務尚不能宣稱完整恢復。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Context-review fraction counts unique warned indicators over unique inputs; repeated list matches count once. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Two hundred unique synthetic indicators yield thirty matches in list A and twenty-five in B, with ten overlapping. Unique warned indicators=30+25−10=45, giving 22.5% requiring context review.

Persistent-data validation counts volumes passing content checks; restored YAML does not prove restored volume data. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. All fifty resource objects restore, but only eight of ten required volumes pass fake-data hash and application-read tests. Object success is 100%, while data validation is 80%; full service recovery is not yet established.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
